en.t: I've been especially energetic lately, haven't I?

units.source_text: 好了，要工作、工作、工作了。」我興奮地說道。

en.t: All right, it's time to work, work, work," I said excitedly.

units.source_text: 我還曾在深更半夜敲過藥店的門。

en.t: I had even knocked on the pharmacy door in the middle of the night.

units.source_text: 老闆娘穿著睡衣，噠噠噠地拄著柺杖走出來，我突然抱住她親，還一邊裝哭。

en.t: The proprietress came out in her nightclothes, tapping along on her crutch, and I suddenly threw my arms around her and kissed her while pretending to cry.

units.source_text: 老闆娘一言不語，遞給我一盒藥。

en.t: Without saying a word, the proprietress handed me a box of medicine.

units.source_text: 藥也跟燒酒一樣，不，甚至比燒酒更可惡更骯髒，

en.t: The medicine was just like shochu; no, it was even more hateful and filthy than shochu,

units.source_text: 當我認識到這一點時，已徹底染上了毒癮，真的是無恥之極。

en.t: By the time I realized that, I was already thoroughly addicted. It was truly the height of shamelessness.

units.source_text: 為了想得到那種藥，我又開始臨摹春宮圖，並與藥店的殘疾老闆娘發生了醜陋的那種關係。

en.t: In order to get that medicine, I again began copying erotic pictures, and entered into that ugly kind of relationship with the disabled proprietress of the pharmacy.
